Experimental: runs the Farming Simulator 25 dedicated server tool (dedicatedServer.exe and its web
interface) under Wine with a virtual display. GIANTS only supports Windows; you upload your own
installed and licensed copy of the game.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Farming Simulator 25 (experimental) install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Nothing can be downloaded: the game is uploaded by the user. This prepares folders and the start script.
set -e
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p game logs

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container

if [ ! -f game/dedicatedServer.exe ]; then
    echo "game/dedicatedServer.exe not found."
    echo "Upload your installed Farming Simulator 25 folder into game/ (see the egg tutorial)."
    exit 1
fi

PROFILE="${WINEPREFIX}/drive_c/users/${USER:-container}/Documents/My Games/FarmingSimulator2025"
mkdir -p "${PROFILE}/mods"
ln -sfn "${PROFILE}" profile

XML=game/dedicatedServer.xml
if [ -f "${XML}" ]; then
    # web interface on the primary allocation, game traffic on the second one
    sed -i -E \
        -e "s#(<webserver[^>]*port=\")[0-9]+#\1${SERVER_PORT}#" \
        -e "s#<port>[0-9]+</port>#<port>${GAME_PORT}</port>#" \
        -e "s#<username>[^<]*</username>#<username>${WEB_USER}</username>#" \
        -e "s#<passphrase>[^<]*</passphrase>#<passphrase>${WEB_PASSWORD}</passphrase>#" \
        "${XML}"
else
    echo "game/dedicatedServer.xml is missing, the web interface will use its defaults."
fi

cd game
wine dedicatedServer.exe > ../logs/dedicatedServer.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
echo "dedicatedServer.exe started, web interface on port ${SERVER_PORT}"
touch "${PROFILE}/log.txt"
tail -n0 -F "${PROFILE}/log.txt" ../logs/dedicatedServer.log --pid=${SERVER_PID}
EOF
chmod 755 start.sh

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Prepared. Upload the installed game into game/ before starting."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
